name: BMHeroRecomp [anylinux]
description:
Bomberman Hero Recompiled is a native PC port of the Nintendo 64 platforming adventure Bomberman Hero. Statically recompiled from the original machine code, it brings the fast-paced gameplay and drum-and-bass soundtrack natively to Linux.

Features:
- Native Linux execution delivering high framerates and zero emulation lag
- Support for modern widescreen and arbitrary desktop display resolutions
- Full compatibility with modern gamepads, analog controls, and keyboard inputs
- High-quality audio output with remastered sound capabilities
- Includes all original stages, boss battles, and unlockable bonus modes

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
